title: sw blend
parentNote: Today is sw at the front of a word — swim, swam, swish. Like the blends of the last few days you really do hear both letters, but this pair is easy to lose: the w is only a quick round of the lips, so it drops out and "swim" comes back as "sim". Say the two sounds slowly yourself — ssss-w — and let your child watch your lips push forward on the w before the word gets going. The other wobble is a vowel sneaking into the middle, "suh-wim"; if you hear that, shorten the hiss and speed the two up until they touch.

activities.mouthCue: Hiss the s with your teeth almost shut, then push your lips into a tight round for the w.
activities.prompt: This pair is not like sh or ch. Here you really do hear both letters — they are just in a hurry.

activities.title: The hot pig
activities.prompt: Read the story one line at a time. Tap any word you want to hear again.
lines: The pig got hot in the sand.
The pig did hop in the pond and swam a bit.
A swift fish did swish past and the pig got a shock.
The pig ran off fast and sat on a damp rock.
The fish had the pond and the pig had the rock!
